# langsmith_tag_keys (Data Source)

Lists all tag keys defined in the current LangSmith workspace.

This data source calls `GET /api/v1/workspaces/current/tag-keys` and returns the full array returned by the API. The LangSmith API does not expose query parameters for filtering, pagination, or sorting on this endpoint; Terraform receives every tag key the server returns for the workspace in a single response.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_tag_keys" "all" {}

output "tag_key_names" {
  value = [for tk in data.langsmith_tag_keys.all.tag_keys : tk.key]
}
```

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the tag key.
- `key` (String) The tag key name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
